---
title: "About the Initiative"
---

## Our vision

We want pharmacometric researchers to be able to test methods against shared datasets that represent the questions the field actually faces. Each benchmark should explain its scientific motivation, document its data and assumptions, and define how a result will be evaluated. This makes comparisons more reproducible and helps identify where new methods are needed.

The Benchmarking Datasets Working Group of the AI/ML SIG is developing this open repository. Hosting under ISoP is planned; the formal relationship and governance details are still being established.

## Two ways to contribute data

[Generic benchmarks](scope.qmd) include teaching cases and focused tests of one modeling phenomenon. They receive a structural review and an assessment of their motivation.

[Grand challenges](scope.qmd) are realistic, consequential drug-development problems. They are intended for deeper scientific review and may support future competitions. The [scope page](scope.qmd) describes the criteria and proposed contributor recognition for each track.

## Join the work

- **Bring a question:** [Open an issue](https://github.com/AIML-SIG/pmx_benchmarks/issues/new) with a pharmacometric problem you would like to see benchmarked.
- **Submit data:** Follow the [submission guide](submission-guide.qmd), even if you are starting with a small synthetic case.
- **Offer expertise:** [Open an issue](https://github.com/AIML-SIG/pmx_benchmarks/issues/new) to volunteer as a reviewer or to help shape the tasks and evaluation criteria.
- **Try a benchmark:** Browse the [benchmark page](benchmarks.qmd) and tell us where the example or submission process could be clearer.

For questions, see [Contact](contact.qmd).
